name: Chaucer Foods
old_description: As leaders in baked and freeze-dried sectors, we collaborate with major retail and foodservice brands worldwide, focusing on tailored and responsibly sourced ingredients to help their products stand out.
about:
Chaucer Foods is headquartered in Forest Grove, Oregon. The company traces its roots to a bakery established in Kent, United Kingdom, though the exact founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been made public.

The company manufactures freeze-dried and baked ingredients for the food and beverage industry. Its core processes include freeze-drying and baking, supported by proprietary supply chain tracking software and direct farmer engagement through agronomists. Chaucer operates manufacturing and development facilities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and China, providing global production capacity. Specific facility sizes, employee counts, and annual volumes are not published.

Chaucer supplies major retail and foodservice brands worldwide. Its ingredients are used in beverage, confectionery, bakery, and foodservice applications. The company works with customers to develop custom formulations and recipes, leveraging research and applications teams.

Chaucer differentiates itself through responsible sourcing, traceability, and customization. The company uses proprietary software to track its supply chain and employs agronomists to work directly with farmers. It emphasizes compliance with third-party audits and leverages world-leading technologies to offer tailored ingredient solutions. The company states that its success is built on quality product, quality service, and quality people.
